I have been thinking about differential forms for quite some time now already.
I still vividly remember 2022 when I was on the "[Konferenz der deutschsprachigen
Mathematikfachschaften](https://koma86.uni-jena.de/)", where I was deeply intrigued by these mysterious objects.
Most mathematicians do in fact not even know what these "$dx$" and "$dy$" and so
on in $\int f(x)\, dx$ are. But I wanted to know! Thus began my years long quest to
find the truth (well, there are many different interpretations of $dx$, like from
measure theory or in this case differential geometry which I wish to inspect in
here).

Previously I have written about these objects here:
[../differential_forms/](../differential_forms/).

I have started a video-series as well though:
